tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise}1. ch11:11-4↗ prob:distance-cut-locus Let $(M, g)$ be a compact Riemannian manifold. Prove that if $R, L$ are positive numbers such that all sectional curvatures of $M$ are less than or equal to $1/R^2$ and all closed geodesics have lengths greater than or equal to $L$, then \[ \text{inj}(M) \geq \min (\pi R, \tfrac {1}{2}L). \] [Hint: Assume not, and use the result of Problem 10-23(b).] \end{exercise}
